name: Mesothelioma
theme: the exposure-made cancer · the IO-doublet rewrite

meta.title: Mesothelioma in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Mesothelioma (pleural primary; peritoneal as its own chapter)
meta.population: Adults with mesothelioma - THE EXPOSURE-MADE CANCER: asbestos with a 20-50 year latency (the range chosen and cited once - sources vary), ~2,800 US cases/yr (CDC 2021 verified figure), male-predominant with US male incidence down ~55% since the 1992 peak while female rates stay stable (SEER - the para-occupational signal, receipt honestly memory-grade). WHO 2021 dropped 'malignant' from the name (verified) and added mesothelioma in situ. THE HISTOLOGY IS THE AXIS: epithelioid / biphasic / sarcomatoid dominates both prognosis AND the immunotherapy effect size - CheckMate 743's verified split is the registry's cleanest effect-modifier teaching (non-epithelioid: nivo+ipi 18.1 vs chemo 8.8 months, HR 0.48; epithelioid: 18.2 vs 16.7, modest) - and THE SARCOMATOID CORRECTION ships with it: the grim '~9-month' figure is the CHEMO arm, not the IO era (correction 27th). THE SURGERY REVERSAL is the signature: MARS2 (verified verbatim) showed extended pleurectomy/decortication made patients live SHORTER (19.3 vs 24.8 months, HR 1.28 [1.02-1.60], p=0.03, triple the serious adverse events) - the operation failed its own trial, no trial anywhere still randomizes it, and the property suite bans pleural cytoreduction from every card while KEEPING the peritoneal operation (CRS+HIPEC, verified 53-month median) - one disease, two cavities, opposite surgical verdicts.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the exposure-made cancer. THE VERIFIED SPINE: platinum-pemetrexed (Vogelzang 2003 - and the acronym worry resolved: EMPHACIS IS the Vogelzang trial; mOS 12.1 vs 9.3, mirror-verified; the 12860935-editorial PMID trap documented) -> bevacizumab MAPS (18.8 vs 16.1 verbatim - guideline-listed, NEVER FDA-approved, filing halted 2017: carried as compendium context, not a card; the MAPS/MAPS2 name collision documented) -> THE IO-DOUBLET REWRITE (CheckMate 743, PMID-verified: mOS 18.1 vs 14.1, HR 0.74 with the 96.6% CI printed correctly - approved 2020-10-02;…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: WHO 2021 pleura/peritoneum (verified: 'malignant' prefix dropped; mesothelioma in situ added; WDPM renamed well-differentiated papillary mesothelial tumor); the profile router = pleural-epithelioid vs pleural-non-epithelioid vs peritoneal (the three-chapter split); borders - lung adenocarcinoma with pleural spread reroutes LIVE (the registry's SIXTEENTH live reroute, to the nsclc trainer); mesothelioma in situ / WDPMT = the surveillance boundary, blocked
meta.response: Imaging response conventional (pleural disease measured by modified RECIST convention); histology-aware prognosis; relapse surveillance imaging-based

Newly diagnosed.name: Nivolumab + ipilimumab (the IO-doublet rewrite - both pleural profiles)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: 1L standard #1 (CheckMate 743 verified; NCCN-listed both histology tracks)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 PMID-verified with verified histology split
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: immune-mediated events (colitis, hepatitis, endocrinopathies) - the CTLA-4 tax
Newly diagnosed.patient: Two immunotherapy drugs and no chemotherapy - the combination that rewrote this disease's outlook, most dramatically for the aggressive cell types.

Newly diagnosed.name: Pembrolizumab + platinum-pemetrexed (the second 1L standard - both pleural profiles)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 verified (journal URL); approval date verified

Newly diagnosed.patient: Immunotherapy added to the classic two-drug chemotherapy - the second modern standard, approved in 2024, with the higher chance of visible shrinkage.

Newly diagnosed.name: Cytoreductive surgery + HIPEC (peritoneal - the cavity where surgery rules)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the peritoneal convention (Yan verified; NCCN separate peritoneal pathway)

Newly diagnosed.toxicity: major abdominal surgery + heated intraperitoneal chemotherapy - a center-dependent undertaking
Newly diagnosed.patient: For abdominal mesothelioma: a major operation removing all visible disease plus heated chemotherapy washed through the abdomen - the one setting in this disease where surgery has strong receipts.

refs.label: WHO 2021 pleura, verified (JTO 'Advances Since the 2015 Classification' - journal-URL match; the paper's PMID held at memory grade, not printed): 'malignant' prefix DROPPED; mesothelioma in situ ADDED as an entity; WDPM renamed well-differentiated papillary mesothelial TUMOR; epithelioid/biphasic/sarcomatoid retained. The mimic border: lung adenocarcinoma vs mesothelioma = the immunostain panel (calretinin/WT1/D2-40 vs TTF-1/napsin - convention-grade)

BAP1 GERMLINE, verified: 'Germline BAP1 mutations and tumor susceptibility' (PMID 21956388, pubmed-url-match) + Testa et al. Nat Genet 2011 'Germline BAP1 mutations predispose to malignant mesothelioma' (journal-URL match; memory-PMID held) + BAP1-TPDS review (40717398, matched): mesothelioma + uveal/cutaneous melanoma + MBAITs + renal - the cascade-screening syndrome; the better-prognosis association memory-grade | PMID 21956388 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE SPINE - Vogelzang 2003, PMID-VERIFIED (12860938, exact title 'Phase III study of pemetrexed in combination with cisplatin versus cisplatin alone...'): mOS 12.1 vs 9.3, HR 0.77; PFS 5.7 vs 3.9; ORR 41% vs 17% (mirror-verified numbers); FDA 2004-02-04 (mirror). ACRONYM WORRY RESOLVED: EMPHACIS IS this trial ('Evaluation of Mesothelioma in a Phase III trial of pemetrexed with CISplatin'). THE PMID TRAP documented: 12860935 = the accompanying EDITORIAL ('...a new standard of care?') - three digits from the trial | PMID 12860938 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

MAPS (bevacizumab), verified VERBATIM (Lancet 2016, Zalcman - journal URL): 'median of 18.8 months (95% CI 15.9-22.6)' vs '16.1 months (14.0-17.9); hazard ratio 0.77 (0.62-0.95); p=0.0167' (memory-PMID 26719230 held). REGULATORY TRUTH verified: NEVER FDA-approved - Genentech/IFCT filing HALTED 2017; NCCN-listed compendium context, on NO card. THE NAME COLLISION documented: MAPS2 (IFCT-1501) is a DIFFERENT trial (relapsed nivo+/-ipi phase 2) - never conflate | PMID 26719230 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE IO-DOUBLET REWRITE - CheckMate 743, PMID-VERIFIED (33485464, exact title): mOS 18.1 (16.8-21.4) vs 14.1 (12.5-16.2); HR 0.74 with 96.6% CI 0.60-0.91 (interim design - NEVER print '95%'). THE EFFECT MODIFIER verified (ASCO Post): non-epithelioid 18.1 vs 8.8 (HR 0.48, 0.34-0.69); epithelioid 18.2 vs 16.7 (modest). FDA APPROVED 2020-10-02 (fda.gov verified; approval summary 34462287 matched). Durability: cite the 5-yr JCO 2026 update (doi 10.1200/JCO-25-01328), not only the 3-yr paper (35124183). NUMBER COLLISIONS documented: 18.1 (overall IO = non-epi IO), 18.2 (epithelioid IO = STELLAR), 16.1 (MAPS control = IND.227 control) | PMID 33485464 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE SECOND 1L STANDARD - IND.227 = KEYNOTE-483, ONE TRIAL TWO NAMES (correction 25th: the Lancet 2023 paper is CCTG IND.227; the FDA letter cites KEYNOTE-483): Chu et al., Lancet 2023 (journal URL, 440 pts): mOS 17.3 (14.4-21.3) vs 16.1; HR 0.79 (0.64-0.98), p=0.0324; ORR 52% vs 29%. FDA APPROVED 2024-09-17 (pembrolizumab + pemetrexed/platinum, 1L unresectable advanced/metastatic - ASCO Post verified). NCCN lists both 1L standards (category detail mirror-grade) | PMID 37931632 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE SURGERY REVERSAL (the signature), VERIFIED VERBATIM - MARS2 (Lim, Lancet Respir Med 2024;12:457-466; PMC11136673): extended P/D + chemo vs chemo alone - '19.3 months' vs '24.8 months'; HR 1.28 (95% CI 1.02-1.60, p=0.03) over 42 months; RMST -1.9 mo; SAE rate ratio 3.6 (2.3-5.5); worse QoL, higher cost. THE 42-MONTH CAVEAT pre-empted: beyond 42 months HR 0.48 (0.18-1.29), n=15/arm - underpowered tail, said first. MARS1 behind it (Treasure, PMID 21723781, matched - EPP harmful signal; ITS NUMBERS HELD at memory grade). THE PMID TRAP: 38740043 is the COMMENTARY ('the future of pleurectomy decortication...'), NOT the trial - the trial's own PMID unresolved this sweep, cite the Lancet Respir Med DOI. Desert verified: NO trial anywhere still randomizes pleural surgery | PMID 38740044 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: Lancet Respir Med + PMC (verbatim; trap documented)

refs.label: TTFields at DEVICE grade, verified: FDA HUMANITARIAN Device Exemption 2019-05 (NovoTTF-100L / Optune Lua + pemetrexed/platinum) on SINGLE-ARM STELLAR (80 pts, mOS 18.2 [12.1-25.8]) - HDE = safety + PROBABLE benefit, NOT demonstrated effectiveness; no randomized meso trial exists or is running (desert verified) - never carded, never ranked (property). The 18.2 number-collision with CM743's epithelioid arm documented

THE WATCH ITEM - ATOMIC-meso, PMID-VERIFIED (38358753; Szlosarek, JAMA Oncol 2024, 249 pts): pegargiminase (ADI-PEG20) + chemo in NON-epithelioid pleural - POSITIVE (mOS 9.3 vs 7.7, mirror-verified; PFS benefit). REGULATORY: rolling BLA initiated 2023-11, final module 2025-06-09, SUBSTANTIVE FDA REVIEW since 2025-08 (Polaris, mirror) - decision pending NOW; Fast Track + Orphan. A decision rewrites the non-epithelioid card within months - THE highest-priority registry re-check | PMID 38358753 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE GRAVEYARD, all PMID-VERIFIED: anetumab ravtansine ARCS-M (35358455, matched - 'did not improve progression-free survival' vs vinorelbine); tremelimumab DETERMINE (28729154, matched - Lancet Oncol 2017, phase 2b, the year/phase corrected); vorinostat VANTAGE-014 (25800891, matched - with the 25800895-COMMENT trap documented); defactinib COMMAND (30785827, matched - PFS 4.1 vs 4.0, futility). Plus: LUME-Meso nintedanib = the phase-2-false-positive arc (ph2 positive -> ph3 negative; memory-grade, flagged); DREAM3R = the terminated-inconclusive arc (correction 22nd: ~174/480 enrolled, OS HR 0.92 [0.63-1.36] NS, ESMO 2025 - NOT practice-changing); DENIM (MesoPher) negative ex-US; PROMISE-meso negative (pembro 2L) | PMID 35358455 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE COUNTERWEIGHT - CONFIRM (UK, phase 3, placebo-controlled): nivolumab POSITIVE in relapsed mesothelioma (OS + PFS - direction verified secondhand; Lancet Oncol 2021 lineage) - the first placebo-controlled IO phase-3 win in the disease, and NOT FDA-APPROVED in this setting (said exactly; UK data point). PROMISE-meso (pembrolizumab 2L vs chemo, ETOP): NEGATIVE for PFS/OS (ORR 22% vs 6% only) - the pair taught together | PMID 34656227 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: Lancet Oncol lineage (secondhand direction; status exact)

refs.label: THE TUMOR-SUPPRESSOR LESSON, verified: BAP1 (~60%), CDKN2A alterations (>80%; homozygous deletion up to 74%), NF2 (30-50%) - NO oncogene driver, NO genotype router (PMC5504107 + TCGA lineage, Hmeljak memory-grade). THE 40% TICKET verified VERBATIM (MRTX1719 Cancer Discovery): 'MTAP deletion is commonly observed in patients with mesotheliomas (~40%)'; among CDKN2A-deleted cases co-deletion 71-91% (20081810, matched). THE HOOKS: MTAP -> PRMT5 MTA-cooperative class; NF2/Hippo -> VT3989 TEAD (Fast Track + Orphan 2025; ORR ~26-32% secondhand, display-grade)
refs.src: Cancer Discovery + TCGA lineage (verbatim ticket; hooks labeled)

refs.label: THE PERITONEAL CHAPTER, verified VERBATIM (Yan, JCO 2009 multi-institutional registry, ~400 pts; memory-PMID held): 'overall median survival was 53 months (1 to 235 months), and 3- and 5-year survival rates were 60% and 47%' - selected disease; predictors: epithelial subtype, no nodal mets, CC-0/1, HIPEC. THE IO TRUTH (correction 26th): NO peritoneal approval (pivotal IO trials EXCLUDED the cavity); the receipt = atezolizumab+bevacizumab phase 2 (Raghav, MD Anderson: ORR 40%, mDOR 12.8 mo, 1-yr OS 85% - secondhand); NCCN peritoneal pathway = extrapolation grade, labeled. The MSK IP-vs-IV randomized phase 2 = the one live randomized peritoneal door (NCT unresolved - flagged) | PMID 19917862 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

EPI, verified (mirror on CDC/SEER): 2,803 US cases in 2021 (CDC - the ~2,800/yr anchor); latency 20-50 years (range CHOSEN once - sources span 20-60); US MALE incidence DOWN ~55% since the 1992 peak, female rates STABLE (SEER - the para-occupational signal; the specific receipt memory-grade: Mazurek MMWR suggested, unverified); male-predominant ~4:1 memory-grade; global burden rising (GBD 38954660 + 38806867, matched) | PMID 38954660 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE PRMT5 SUITE (MTAP-deleted; MTA-cooperative class): BMS-986504/MRTX1719 (NCT05245500, ~22 US sites, RECRUITING; the Mirati->BMS asset; early meso responses secondhand) + AMG 193 anvumetostat (NCT05094336, recruiting) + TNG462 (NCT05732831, +/- pembro; TNG908 predecessor) - ALL NCTs UNVERIFIED (MCP down), corroborated secondhand - web-verified 2026-08-20. The disease's first biomarker-gated door layer (~40% eligible)

THE CELL LAYER told exactly: gavo-cel (TC-210) DEAD as a door (correction 24th: TCR2->Adaptimmune merger 2023; 2025 restructuring sold sarcoma assets, refocused PRAME/CD70; NCT03907852 ACTIVE-NOT-RECRUITING; phase-1 ORR ~20%, Nat Med) - what survives is ACADEMIC: NCI hYP218 TNhYP218 CAR (NCT06885697, recruiting early-2026 secondhand, UNVERIFIED) + Penn intrapleural huCART-meso +/- pembro (OS 23.9 mo in responders, secondhand). No new mesothelin ADC door post-anetumab (desert)

THE SHELF + THE DESERTS: eVOLVE-Meso (NCT06097728, UNVERIFIED) - enrollment COMPLETE ~863, readout ~2028, NO 2026 action (correction 23rd); AstraZeneca discontinued sibling eVOLVE-Lung02 in 2026 but KEPT eVOLVE-Meso (class caution said both ways); DREAM3R terminated-inconclusive; NERO/MiST PARP franchise UK/ex-US (NEVER a US door; NERO 27% PFS-event reduction hypothesis-grade); galinpepimut-S status UNVERIFIED; DENIM negative ex-US; VT3989 pivotal design = watch. DESERTS verified: randomized pleural surgery (closed by MARS2), randomized TTFields (none), peritoneal IO phase 3 (none), US PARP door (none), post-anetumab mesothelin ADC (none)

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.
